SELECT e.exam_id, e.semester_id, e.course_id, e.exam_name, e.exam_date, e.total_score, e.exam_status, COUNT(r.exam_record_id) AS assigned_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.record_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count FROM t_exam_exam e LEFT JOIN t_exam_record r ON r.exam_id = e.exam_id
e.deleted_flag = b'0' AND e.semester_id = #{query.semesterId} AND e.course_id = #{query.courseId} AND e.exam_status = #{query.examStatus}
AND INSTR(e.exam_name, #{query.examName})
GROUP BY e.exam_id, e.semester_id, e.course_id, e.exam_name, e.exam_date, e.total_score, e.exam_status ORDER BY e.exam_date DESC, e.exam_id DESC

SELECT e.exam_id, e.exam_name, e.total_score, e.pass_score, COUNT(r.exam_record_id) AS assigned_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.record_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participant_count, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.record_status = 2 THEN r.total_score END), 2), 0) AS average_score, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN r.record_status = 2 THEN r.total_score END), 0) AS highest_score, COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN r.record_status = 2 THEN r.total_score END), 0) AS lowest_score, COALESCE(ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.record_status = 2 AND r.total_score >= e.pass_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.record_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2), 0) AS pass_rate FROM t_exam_exam e LEFT JOIN t_exam_record r ON r.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE e.exam_id = #{examId} AND e.deleted_flag = b'0' GROUP BY e.exam_id, e.exam_name, e.total_score, e.pass_score

SELECT ranges.score_range, COUNT(r.exam_record_id) AS student_count FROM ( SELECT '0-59' score_range, 1 sort_no UNION ALL SELECT '60-69', 2 UNION ALL SELECT '70-79', 3 UNION ALL SELECT '80-89', 4 UNION ALL SELECT '90-100', 5 ) ranges LEFT JOIN t_exam_record r ON r.exam_id = #{examId} AND r.record_status = 2 AND ranges.score_range = CASE WHEN r.total_score < 60 THEN '0-59' WHEN r.total_score < 70 THEN '60-69' WHEN r.total_score < 80 THEN '70-79' WHEN r.total_score < 90 THEN '80-89' ELSE '90-100' END GROUP BY ranges.score_range, ranges.sort_no ORDER BY ranges.sort_no

SELECT FROM t_exam_record r INNER JOIN t_exam_student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id
r.exam_id = #{query.examId} AND r.record_status = #{query.completionStatus}
AND (INSTR(s.student_no, #{query.studentKeyword}) OR INSTR(s.student_name, #{query.studentKeyword}))
ORDER BY r.record_status ASC, r.total_score DESC, s.student_no ASC

SELECT r.exam_record_id, e.exam_id, e.exam_name, s.student_id, s.student_no, s.student_name, r.submit_time, r.total_score FROM t_exam_record r INNER JOIN t_exam_exam e ON e.exam_id = r.exam_id INNER JOIN t_exam_student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id WHERE r.exam_id = #{examId} AND r.student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT answer_id, question_id, question_content, student_answer, ai_score, final_score, max_score, ai_comment FROM t_exam_answer WHERE exam_record_id = #{examRecordId} ORDER BY question_id, answer_id

SELECT s.student_no, s.student_name, CASE r.record_status WHEN 0 THEN '未开始' WHEN 1 THEN '进行中' WHEN 2 THEN '已提交' ELSE '未知' END AS completion_status_name, r.submit_time, r.total_score FROM t_exam_record r INNER JOIN t_exam_student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id WHERE r.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY r.total_score DESC, s.student_no ASC

SELECT s.student_no, s.student_name, CASE r.record_status WHEN 0 THEN '未开始' WHEN 1 THEN '进行中' ELSE '未知' END AS completion_status_name, r.last_active_time FROM t_exam_record r INNER JOIN t_exam_student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id WHERE r.exam_id = #{examId} AND r.record_status != 2 ORDER BY r.record_status, s.student_no
